findings.title: Checkpoint goroutine exits permanently on a posting error
findings.message: Any non-queue-full error from PostWindow permanently stops the autosave ticker goroutine, so recovery capture silently ceases for the rest of the session. A transient failure disables crash recovery with no user notice.
findings.suggestion: Only exit when ctx is done or the window/app is closed; otherwise retry on the next tick and surface the error via status.

findings.title: Recovery restore may leave stale history semantics
findings.message: Restore Recovery installs the notebook while the user is looking at a recovery prompt, but `f.lastRecovery` is not reset and the model is not checked for settlement/pending state. Also the Restore button calls journal.Replace(false...) which appears not to reset session history; the README claims fresh session history, and the test only asserts UndoCount==0 on fresh start.
findings.suggestion: Verify Replace(false) marks the journal dirty with cleared history, and add tests covering restore after prior edits.
